{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
valid_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
